cli: node <SM>/session-manager.mjs <subcommand> [args] [--project-root <abs>]. The canonical copy of this reference is the CLI's --help (cli-usage.mjs). GLOBAL: every subcommand accepts --project-root <absolute dir> (default cwd; relative -> exit 2) and -h/--help. Unknown subcommand, unknown flag or extra positional -> exit 2. stdout is ONE line of JSON (except repo-dir --raw: a bare path plus newline); errors go to stderr; on exit 3 and 4 the JSON body is ALSO printed on stdout. Untrusted text is read from STDIN only (pipe it; a TTY stdin -> exit 2). EXIT CODES: 0 ok; 1 a command failed (claude/tmux/gh missing or non-zero, I/O error); 2 bad repo, bad or absent config, or bad usage; 3 no capacity; 4 a live worker already holds the ref. --- capacity [--max-workers <n>] -> {running,cap,free_slots,avail_gb,load1,cores,overloaded,can_spawn,mem_source,paused}. Runs `claude agents --json` (no --all). Works with NO sessionManager block (SESSION_MANAGER_DEFAULTS.capacity); an invalid block -> exit 2. Cap precedence: ledger control.maxWorkers, then --max-workers, then config. --- spawn <ref> [--repo <key>] [--max-workers <n>] -> {ref,name,sessionId,repo,cwd}. Order: config required and valid (2); resolveRepoDir + dir must contain .lisa.config.json (2); `claude agents --json --all`; capacity (3, stdout = capacity report); findLiveWorker exact token (4, stdout = {ref,worker,sessionId}); name = buildWorkerName(ref, now, names from agents + ledger items + ledger history); spawnSync('claude', ['--bg','-n',<name>,'--dangerously-skip-permissions','--settings','{"crossSessionInbound":"accept"}','/lisa:implement <ref> managedBy=<sessionManager.name>'], {cwd: repoDir, env: scrubWorkerEnv(env)}); non-zero -> exit 1 and nothing recorded; parseSessionId (null -> stderr warning, still exit 0); recordSpawn (repo = key or '.') and appendSessionEvent {event:'spawn',ref,worker,sessionId,repo,cwd}. --- resume <ref>, STDIN = message -> {ref,worker,sessionId,resumed:true}. Reads the ledger item (absent or no sessionId -> 2; empty stdin -> 2); runs claude --bg --resume <ledger sessionId> <stdin text, trimmed, ONE argv element> with cwd = the item's repo dir and the scrubbed env; appends {event:'resume'}. It does not clear the pending question (use ledger clear-question). --- classify [<ref>] -> [{ref,worker,sessionId,repo,classification,attempts,agentStatus,pendingQuestion}]; classification in finished|waiting|requestion|working|stalled|dead|exhausted. No ref = every ledger item (sorted). Uses `claude agents --json --all` matched by exact worker name, and sha256 of `claude logs <worker>` (only when the agent row exists; failure -> null); classifies against the PREVIOUS hash, then records the new one with recordProgress. Stall policy from config.stall, else DEFAULT_STALL. Unknown ref -> 2. --- status -> {manager:{name,running},control,workers:[{ref,worker,sessionId,repo,status,attempts,pendingQuestion:boolean,live}],untracked:[active wk- names not in the ledger]}. running = `tmux has-session -t <name>` exit 0. --- start -> {status:'started',name,stateDir,attach:'tmux attach -t <name>'} | {status:'already-running',name}. Config required; resolveStateDir refuses the shared default dir (2); tmux has-session -> already-running (exit 0, no launch); assertTokenPresent(<stateDir>/.env, owner-only mode) else 2; then tmux <buildManagerLaunch({name,root,stateDir,scriptsDir: dirname(session-manager.mjs),interval})> with cwd root and the scrubbed env (so a fresh tmux server never inherits TELEGRAM_*). tmux missing -> 2. --- stop -> {status:'stopped'|'not-running',name}. Runs only tmux kill-session -t <name>; never touches workers. --- store-token -> {stored:true,path} (0) | {stored:false,reason:'no-tty',command} (0; command = "node '<SM>/session-manager.mjs' store-token --project-root '<root>'") | {stored:false,reason:'empty'|'invalid',message} (2). Config required; the default shared state dir -> 2. Never prints the token. --- repo-dir [--repo <key>] [--raw] -> {repo,dir} or, with --raw, the bare absolute dir and a newline (use: cd "$(node "$SM/session-manager.mjs" repo-dir --repo <key> --raw --project-root "$ROOT")"). Single-repo: no --repo (or '.') = project root. Unknown key, a key on a single-repo project, or a dir without .lisa.config.json -> 2. --- validate -> {valid,errors} (exit 0 valid, 2 otherwise). errors = validateSessionManager(resolved block) + every repos.entries dir that lacks .lisa.config.json + a refused notify.stateDir. Absent block -> {valid:false,errors:['No sessionManager block in .lisa.config.json.']} exit 2. --- init-config [--slug <slug>] [--write] -> {written:false,block} | {written:true,path,block} | {written:false,reason:'exists',block:<existing>}. slug default: github.repo, else basename(project root). Detects projects/*/.lisa.config.json. --write adds sessionManager to the existing .lisa.config.json (missing file -> 2) and never overwrites an existing block. Non-secret fields only. --- queue --tracker github [--me <id>] [--label <name>] [--github-repo <owner/repo>] -> runs gh api --paginate --slurp 'repos/<o>/<r>/issues?state=open&labels=<urlencoded label>&per_page=100' (scrubbed env; non-zero -> 1), flattens pages, normalizeGithubIssue (drops PR rows). Label default: resolveRole({role:'ready',vendor:'github',intent:'read'}) from local then global config (github.labels.build.ready); none -> 2. Repo default: github.org + github.repo (local over global); none -> 2. queue --tracker jira|linear --input <file> [--me <id>]: <file> = {complete:true,pages,items:[RAW vendor issues: Jira {key,fields} / Linear GraphQL issue nodes]}; missing --input, unreadable or non-JSON file, complete !== true, or items not an array -> 2; items go through normalizeJiraIssue / normalizeLinearIssue. Both -> {tracker,me,total,pages,ordered:[normalized items],excluded:[{ref,reason}]} from orderReadyQueue(items,{me,trustedAuthorIds: sessionManager.trustedAuthorIds}). --me default: ledger control.me. Any other --tracker -> 2. --- ledger get [<ref>] -> whole ledger {version,items,control} or one item (unknown ref -> 2). ledger record-spawn <ref> --worker <name> [--session-id <id>] [--repo <key>] -> item (attempts++). ledger set-question <ref> [--telegram-message-id <n>], STDIN = question text (required) -> item. ledger clear-question <ref> -> item. ledger finish <ref> --status DONE|FAILED, STDIN = reason (may be empty) -> item. ledger control [--paused true|false] [--max-workers <0..32>|none] [--me <id>|none] -> control {paused,maxWorkers,me}. Unknown action -> 2; module validation refusals -> 2. --- route [--reply-to <telegram message id>] [--owner <name>], STDIN = the Telegram message -> {kind:'answer',ref,body[,message:"<owner>'s answer: <body>"]} | {kind:'command',name:'status'|'pause'|'resume'} | {kind:'command',name:'cap',value} | {kind:'command',name:'stop',ref} | {kind:'ambiguous',candidates}. message is added only for an answer when --owner is given. --- blocked-plan [--input <file>] [--ref <ref>], STDIN (when no --input) = JSON {labels,body,comments,trustedHumanActorIds?,humanNeededLabel?,edges:[{ref?,contained,blockerState,blockerReason,...}],pendingQuestion?} -> {action:'release'|'keep'|'escalate'|'skip-human-gate',reason,edges,gate}. --ref fills pendingQuestion from the ledger when the input has none. Non-JSON -> 2. --- record-cycle --outcome <nothing-needed|candidate-proposed|change-proved|approval-requested|recovery-required|policy-obsolete> [--ref <url>]... [--run-id <id>], STDIN = one-line summary (required) -> {path,appended,loop_id,outcome,run_id}. Calls recordAutomationRun({loopId:'session-manager', runbook:'.lisa/automations/session-manager.runbook.md', ...}); writes .lisa/automations/runs/session-manager.jsonl. Bad outcome or empty summary -> 2. --- HIDDEN TEST-ONLY FLAG (listed in --help as test-only; skills never pass it): --meminfo <file> on capacity and spawn reads memory from a Linux meminfo file (platform forced to linux) instead of this host.
tests: bunx vitest run tests/unit/session-manager/ -> 15 files, 295 passed (the new cli*.test.ts files: 57 tests, plus 238 existing sibling tests, all green). RED first: 56 of 57 new tests failed before session-manager.mjs existed. Covered: exit 2 (bare repo dir, unknown repo key, absent block, invalid block, missing ref, empty resume stdin, unknown ledger ref, start without .env, group-readable .env, shared default state dir, jira/linear without --input, complete:false paging guard, missing ready label, unknown tracker/outcome/subcommand/flag, relative --project-root); exit 3 (--max-workers 0); exit 4 (live wk- worker; plus the exact-token negative: DEMO-1 is not blocked by a DEMO-12 worker); exit 1 (claude --bg fails, nothing recorded); the exact claude --bg argv; cwd = project root or projects/<key>; TELEGRAM_STATE_DIR and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN absent from the worker env on spawn and resume; resume text with $(), backticks and quotes arrives as one argv element; the start argv equals launch.mjs buildManagerLaunch; stop only kills the manager session; gh --paginate --slurp argv with the URL-encoded label and mine-first order. vm_stat stub test runs only on darwin (it.runIf); every other test uses --meminfo, so the suite is host-independent. oxlint 0/0 on all new files; eslint --no-ignore 0 errors on all new files; prettier clean; tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json reports 0 errors in the new files (it reports 32 existing errors in sibling tests: capacity.test.ts 12, ledger.test.ts 11, reconcile.test.ts 5, workers-classify.test.ts 3, workers.test.ts 1, none of them touched by T10). Every new file is under 300 lines.

deviations: Split across 7 skill-local modules instead of one session-manager.mjs, to keep each under 300 lines: session-manager.mjs (entry, argv specs, the single env read, exit mapping, runtime-parity header), cli-runtime.mjs (CliError, EXIT, config load and validate, spawnSync wrappers, stdin), cli-workers.mjs (capacity, spawn, resume, classify), cli-manager.mjs (start, stop, status, repo-dir, validate, init-config, store-token), cli-queue.mjs (queue), cli-cycle.mjs (ledger, route, blocked-plan, record-cycle) and cli-usage.mjs (the --help text). These are new untracked files; no tracked file was edited.

Tests are split across cli.test.ts, cli-manager.test.ts, cli-cycle.test.ts and cli-messages.test.ts, with shared helpers in tests/unit/session-manager/support/. The support/ location is required: eslint.config.local.ts exempts tests/**/support/** from the process.env and immutable-data rules for exactly this kind of harness. For the same reason the stub recorder is tests/fixtures/session-manager/support/stub-record.mjs.
Added a stub gh (tests/fixtures/session-manager/stub-bin/gh), which was not in the file list, to test queue --tracker github without the network.

queue --tracker github uses `gh api --paginate --slurp` (gh wraps the pages in one JSON array). Plain --paginate concatenates arrays as invalid JSON. Flags added beyond the AC: --label and --github-repo override the configured ready label and repo.
repo-dir has a --raw flag that prints a bare path for `cd "$(...)"`. The AC says every subcommand prints JSON (the default here), but the design's cd snippet needs a bare path.

jira/linear queue --input items are RAW vendor issues, normalized by the CLI with normalizeJiraIssue/normalizeLinearIssue. They are not pre-normalized items. T11 must write raw issues into the envelope.
Untrusted text reaches set-question, finish, route, record-cycle and blocked-plan on STDIN, and resume's answer as well. record-cycle has no --summary flag.
start probes `tmux has-session` before checking the token file, so a running manager reports already-running even if its .env was since removed. tmux runs with the scrubbed env.
Added --help documentation for the hidden --meminfo flag, marked test-only, to satisfy 'document every flag'.

learnings.note: Put shared test harnesses that read process.env or keep a list of temp dirs to remove under tests/**/support/**. eslint.config.local.ts turns off no-restricted-syntax (process.env) and functional/immutable-data there; the same code in tests/unit/x/harness.ts fails lint.
learnings.evidence: eslint --no-ignore errors on tests/unit/session-manager/cli-harness.ts and tests/fixtures/session-manager/stub-record.mjs, which cleared after the move to support/; eslint.config.local.ts lines 45-62

learnings.note: The vitest scratch guard fails a suite that leaves mkdtemp dirs behind ('leaked N unregistered scratch fixture(s)'), even when every test passed. A harness that makes temp dirs must remove them in afterEach.
learnings.evidence: First green run: 57 passed but 3 suites FAIL with 'Suite lisa leaked 17 unregistered scratch fixture(s): sm-cli-*'

learnings.note: The parity-safety-net hook blocks rm -rf of any variable path, even inside a script the command runs; only $TMPDIR is allowed. It also blocks heredocs in Bash and refuses to run a script named by a variable. Write scripts with the Write tool, run them by literal path, and keep temp trees in the scratchpad without deleting them.
learnings.evidence: Three PreToolUse:Bash refusals while running the stubbed verification script

learnings.note: Exec bits survive into git: core.fileMode is true here, and a dry add into a throwaway GIT_INDEX_FILE recorded every stub-bin file and session-manager.mjs as 100755. The real index was not touched.
learnings.evidence: GIT_INDEX_FILE=<scratch> git add ...; git ls-files -s -> 100755 for claude, gh, tmux, vm_stat and session-manager.mjs

learnings.note: tsconfig.tests.json uses nodenext resolution, so a relative import from a test to a .ts helper needs a .js extension (./support/cli-harness.js); an import without an extension gives TS2835. Some sibling session-manager tests have existing tsc errors (32 in total) that the lead should clear before the typecheck gate.
learnings.evidence: tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json: TS2835 on the new imports before the fix; residual errors only in capacity/ledger/reconcile/workers tests

learnings.note: eslint max-lines skips blank and comment lines, so a well-commented 337-line file passes lint but breaks the team's 'under 300 lines' rule. Check sizes with wc -l, not with lint alone.
learnings.evidence: cli-harness.ts at 337 wc lines raised no max-lines error
